title: オリジナルのロボット仲間
subject_en: ORIGINAL friendly robot characters invented for this series (not any existing robot or franchise), each a separate chubby robot with a distinct silhouette, a simple glowing face screen and one signature pastel colour each. Matte clay look. Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text.
lead: まんまるロボ、掃除ロボ、花を育てるロボ。どこにもいない、オリジナルのやさしいロボット12体。ゲームやイベントのキャラに。
items: a perfectly round mint-green robot with two tiny arms and a smile screen
a flat disc-shaped yellow cleaning robot with a small brush and a happy face
a pink robot with a watering can arm and a flower growing on its head
a white-blue robot with a chef hat and a ladle hand
a small blue robot whose head is an umbrella
a tall thin orange robot with long legs and a cheerful face
a tiny peach-coloured robot with a big head and wheels
a bird-shaped cream robot with propeller wings
a cat-shaped lavender robot with antenna ears
a green robot with an open book for a chest
a coral robot with a speaker belly and musical note antennae
a grey-blue robot with half-closed screen eyes and a blanket scarf
